name: inkbolt
description: Local vector and raster editing engine for agents: layered documents, saved sessions and exports.
long_description: Edit vector paths, pixels, text, artboards and layered documents with local saved sessions and bounded image and SVG exports. This bundle contains the Windows x64 binary and its compact MCP tool catalog. The engine needs no network, listener or account at runtime. Choose an existing local workspace for documents, resources and exports. Unsupported editing and interchange semantics fail explicitly.

tools.name: inkbolt_asset_import
tools.description: Import a supported local image into an immutable store with explicit color policies, preserving the source.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_check
tools.description: Check document structure, pinned resources and text overflow with bounded diagnostics and repair guidance.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_create
tools.description: Create an empty editable vector or raster sRGB snapshot without saving a file.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_edit
tools.description: Apply a checked atomic batch of operations to a snapshot, leaving files unchanged.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_inspect
tools.description: Inspect item IDs, hierarchy, visibility, locks, transforms, geometry bounds and resources.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_inspect_page
tools.description: Read bounded pages of item fields, resource inventories or path anchors tied to exact document content.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_preview
tools.description: Preview a canvas, region, objects or artboard as PNG with document identity and coordinate maps.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_query
tools.description: Find editable item IDs by type, shape and geometry bounds, with optional path-anchor inspection.

tools.name: inkbolt_document_render
tools.description: Render a bounded snapshot into straight RGBA8 hex pixels using its declared resource stores.

tools.name: inkbolt_font_import
tools.description: Import a permitted local outline font and its UTF-8 license into immutable storage.

tools.name: inkbolt_run
tools.description: Run any engine command through the shared validated executor with unchanged revision and publication checks.

tools.name: inkbolt_schema_lookup
tools.description: Discover command arguments and graphics types through focused schemas, outlines and selected definitions.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_apply
tools.description: Commit an atomic session action with expected-revision checks and durable request-ID retries.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_apply_proposal
tools.description: Commit a reviewed dry-run proposal only while its revision, action and content still match.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_create
tools.description: Create a durable local editing session without overwriting another session.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_diff
tools.description: Compare two committed session revisions with their saved resource bindings.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_diff_preview
tools.description: Compare immutable revisions with aligned PNG previews, a change mask, pixel deltas and coordinate maps.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_dry_run
tools.description: Evaluate a session action without changing its database and return a content-bound proposal.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_history
tools.description: Page committed history receipts in revision order.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_publish
tools.description: Publish the expected session revision to new output files, optionally retaining a durable recovery receipt.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_read
tools.description: Read the current session or a named snapshot with resources, revision and history depths.

tools.name: inkbolt_session_receipt
tools.description: Recover the original committed document and receipt by request ID after a lost response.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Existing local folder inside which Inkbolt reads and writes your files. Commands create .inkbolt/sessions, .inkbolt/assets, .inkbolt/fonts, .inkbolt/publications and .inkbolt/jobs stores as needed; startup and discovery create nothing. Choose a project folder to keep its files together. Workspace checks are not an OS sandbox.
